'''Bloodveld''' can be found in the [[Heart of Gielinor]], requiring level 50 [[Slayer]]. They can be fought for killcount for the [[Zamorak]] faction.

Equipping a [[Zamorak insignia]] or [[shard of Mah]] makes them non-aggressive.
